flow.name: axn-term - Keycloak login and WebSocket shell
flow.description: Start the axn-term scenario and use Playwright to verify that a user can log in through Keycloak and land in a working WebShell backed by the .NET gateway.

step.description: Open the shell UI, log in with Keycloak, and wait for the container terminal prompt

assert.value: Shell login and WebSocket connection verified
assert.description: Step reports a successful login and WebSocket shell connection
